findings.body: Raise: Not done. When the review is active, the test allows the board row to say “Review running,” but its `forge next` assertion still searches only for tests running or “review running.” `src/forge/nextstep.py:53` instead prints “The fix ... is being reviewed,” and lines 690–693 suppress the tests-running message while a review is active. The assertion at line 63 therefore fails in the scenario this fix targets. The test does not synchronize on review startup, so the reported passes can exercise only the no-review path.
